title: Cone-preserving cylinder rectification of a homotopy square
statement: Let E be an abelian category with derived category [def-pc-derived-category], let C,D,C′,D′ be integer-indexed cochain complexes, and let t:C→D, t′:C′→D′, α:C→C′, β:D→D′ have a specified homotopy H:t≫β~α≫t′. There exist T, i:C→T, b:T→D′ and hc:i≫b=α≫t′, together with eD:Q(T)≅Q(D) and eCone:Q(Cone(i))≅Q(Cone(t)), such that Q(b)=eD.hom≫Q(β) and Q(Cone.map(i,t′,α,b,hc))=eCone.hom≫Q(Cone.mapOfHomotopy H). Only the source middle complex and its cone are replaced.

source.place: Tags 013N and 013O (explicit cylinder and contraction), with the homotopy cone formulas of Tag 014P.

proof.text: Put T=D⊕Cone(id C), i=(t,inr(id C)). If h is the cochain of H, delta h=t beta-alpha t′. Construct k=Cone.desc(id C,-h,alpha t′-t beta) and b=(beta,k). The cone differential gives a chain map k, and i b=t beta+(alpha t′-t beta)=alpha t′ strictly.

The identity cone is contractible by Mathlib mappingCone.homotopyToZeroOfId. Its localized maps vanish. Thus Q(fst):Q(T)→Q(D) is invertible with inverse Q(inl), and Q(b)=Q(fst) Q(beta). The strict square (id C,fst) induces q:Cone(i)→Cone(t). Its localized cone-triangle morphism has its first two maps invertible, so Pretriangulated.isIso₃_of_isIso₁₂ gives invertibility of Q(q).

Set z=ofHom(snd) composed with descCochain(id C,0,-h) composed with ofHom(inr t′). For the maps F=Cone.map(i,t′,alpha,b) and G=q Cone.mapOfHomotopy H, use mappingCone.descHomotopy with cochains 0 and z. The first equation follows from i snd=inr(id C), whose composite with descCochain is -h. For the second, delta z=ofHom(snd) composed with ofHom(k) composed with ofHom(inr t′), by delta_ofHomotopy and delta_descCochain. Expand inl and inr of the biproduct and desc_f to verify both equations. This proves F homotopic to G; DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_of_homotopy yields their localized equality. Use the two constructed localized isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem homotopy_square_cone_rectification
    {E : Type u} [Category E] [Abelian E] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} E]
    {C D C' D' : CochainComplex E ℤ}
    (t : C ⟶ D) (t' : C' ⟶ D') (α : C ⟶ C') (β : D ⟶ D')
    (H : Homotopy (t ≫ β) (α ≫ t')) :
    ∃ (T : CochainComplex E ℤ) (i : C ⟶ T) (b : T ⟶ D')
      (hc : i ≫ b = α ≫ t')
      (eD : DerivedCategory.Q.obj T ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj D)
      (eCone : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (mappingCone i) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (mappingCone t)),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map b = eD.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map β ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (mappingCone.map i t' α b hc) =
        eCone.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H)
